title: Clappy Sipster
summary: A wearable Clappy‑inspired costume that incorporates a smart drink dispenser, letting wearers instantly serve personalized beverages to strangers, instantly breaking the ice and fostering instant social connections.
concept: Clappy Sipster transforms the traditional networking or cosplay event into an interactive, social‑drinking experience. The costume, mimicking the iconic Clappy’s bright colors and distinctive shape, is embedded with a compact, rechargeable drink dispensing unit. When a wearer approaches someone, the unit is triggered by a gentle tap on the logo or by a voice command, and within seconds a personalized beverage—water, juice, mock‑cocktail, or even a hot drink—is poured into a cup that the receiver can hold. The act of receiving a drink serves as a non‑verbal invitation to talk. Behind the scenes, the device communicates with the wearer’s smartphone via Bluetooth, allowing them to pre‑select flavors, set portion sizes, or even load a short ice‑breaker script that can be read aloud by a small speaker. The garment’s flexible housing keeps the components lightweight and comfortable, while a sensor network detects when a handshake or introduction occurs, automatically logging the encounter for follow‑up. mechanism: The core of Clappy Sipster is a modular microfluidic dispenser housed within a lightweight chassis that conforms to the costume’s silhouette. The dispenser consists of a 300‑ml reservoir, a peristaltic pump, and a small solenoid valve to control flow. Fluid selection is managed by a microcontroller that interfaces with the wearer’s smartphone via BLE. The smartphone app stores user‑preferred drink profiles and displays an intuitive UI for selecting a drink before approaching someone. When the wearer taps the Clappy logo or speaks a voice command, the microcontroller receives a trigger and initiates the dispensing sequence: the pump draws liquid from the reservoir, the valve opens, and a pre‑set volume is delivered in under two seconds. A miniature Bluetooth speaker within the unit can optionally play a pre‑recorded ice‑breaker message to accompany the drink. Sensors integrated into the costume detect physical proximity (using RFID tags embedded in guests’ event badges) and a gentle hand‑shake motion.
